summary: Blue Owl Real Estate Net Lease Trust filed an 8-K reporting a routine unregistered issuance of 2,883,572 Class I common shares to feeder vehicles created to hold the class, for gross proceeds of roughly $31.0 million, priced at the September 30, 2026 NAV per share (Class I $10.7668), with the final share count set October 16, 2026. The sale relied on Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D and/or Regulation S exemptions. Item 8.01 separately discloses monthly NAV per share by class as of September 30, 2026, with total NAV of approximately $10.06 billion across 937.4 million shares and units. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or transaction terms apply; this is ordinary periodic capital raising and NAV disclosure, not a special situation. Watch for continued NAV-per-share drift and future feeder-vehicle subscriptions.
